name: openworks_land_use_partition
crs_note: EPSG:4326 exchange; areas computed in EPSG:4548
derivation_note: Partition derived by splitting the submitted boundary; the whole planar graph is noded and polygonised in EPSG:4548 with the site boundary ring participating in the graph, so the interior faces tile the site exactly. Verified in EPSG:4548: inter-unit overlap 0.000 sqm, uncovered gap 0.000 sqm, area beyond the boundary 0.000 sqm, symmetric difference 0.000 sqm — a constructive zero, not a degree-space artefact. Absolute area accuracy remains limited by the provisional_rough boundary; every value must be recomputed once the official redline arrives.
